description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing Account entities in a Room database within an Android application. It includes methods for inserting, deleting, updating, and querying Account data, with specific queries for retrieving accounts by ID, name, or counting total accounts.
external_methods: Account (constructor or entity class in the project)

classes.name: AccountDao
classes.description: An interface annotated with @Dao that provides methods for accessing and manipulating Account entities within the Room database.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts an Account object into the database and returns the row ID as long.

methods.name: deleteAccount
methods.description: Deletes the specified Account object from the database.

methods.name: getAccounts$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of all Account objects in the database.

methods.name: getAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of all Account objects in the database.

methods.name: getAccountById$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData object containing a single Account identified by its ID.

methods.name: getAccountById
methods.description: Retrieves an Account object from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getAccountByName
methods.description: Fetches an Account object that matches the provided account name.

methods.name: countAccounts$
methods.description: Returns a LiveData integer representing the total number of Account entries in the database.

methods.name: updateBrand
methods.description: Updates the color associated with the specified Account ID.

methods.name: updateETag
methods.description: Updates the ETag of the Account with the specified ID.

methods.name: updateCapabilitiesETag
methods.description: Updates the capabilities ETag for the Account identified by the given ID.

methods.name: updateModified
methods.description: Sets the modified timestamp for the specified Account.

methods.name: updateApiVersion
methods.description: Updates the API version information for the given Account, returns an integer indicating the number of rows affected.

methods.name: updateDisplayName
methods.description: Sets a new display name for the specified Account.

methods.name: updateDirectEditingAvailable
methods.description: Updates the flag indicating whether direct editing is available for the Account.
